dialogs.dialog_name: CANCELLATION REASON SELECT dialog (legacy title not documented)

elements.label: cancellation reason list
elements.notes: Each reason is a code of up to 10 characters plus a description. About ten system defaults exist that cannot be inactivated - only these four are named - and offices add their own reasons, so the list is tenant data and the four values are a PARTIAL list.

dialogs.evidence_quote: Reason (code up to 10 characters + description; about ten system defaults that cannot be inactivated, such as `Cancelled by office`, `Cancelled same day`, `No reason provided`, `Cancelled by Denticon Patient Engagement`; offices add their own)
dialogs.notes: The document describes the cancellation-reason records and says the criterion limits the cancelled appointments to the chosen reasons (system and office-defined). The dialog itself - title, checkboxes, sort options, search field, list columns - is not described in this document, which refers to legacy_report_outputs_daily_my.md for the picker dialogs. Opened from Appointment List (enabled with Cancelled List) and from Appointment Detail (greyed by default).

dialogs.dialog_name: RECALL PROCEDURE CODES SELECT dialog (legacy title not documented)

elements.label: procedure code list
elements.notes: On Procedural Recall Report any procedure code can be chosen, not only recallable ones (ALL = every completed code). On Recall Due Report ALL stands for every recallable code; whether the list itself is limited to recallable codes there and on Scheduled Recall Report is not stated. Recallable codes are the procedure codes flagged recallable (with a recall interval) in procedure-code setup; they include office-defined codes that offices use for non-dental recalls such as membership renewal or a yearly consent.

dialogs.evidence_quote: Any code can be chosen, not only recallable ones
